title: review-findings/v1 record
description: DRAFT (draft_revision 1) -- NOT FROZEN. One immutable observation record: 'what a reviewer found (or did not find, or could not determine) in one recorded scan_scope of one subject digest.' A record never edits another; a correction is a NEW record naming the old one via supersedes_record_id, and a different subject.digest (e.g. after a fix) makes it a DIFFERENT subject by construction -- the old record's findings are not silently migrated forward. This contract carries NO promotion authority: it only records what was observed. See docs/protocols/review-findings-v1.md. NOTE: the spec's field name 'reviewer' collides with contracts/shared/personal-dimensions.mjs's forbidden-key set (same collision decision/v1 already hit with 'reviewer'/'critic_engine' -- see that protocol's own note); this schema uses 'assessor' instead, naming the SAME concept (kind of thing that produced the finding, never a person), to keep every accepting fixture passing the mandatory personal-dimension scan.

recorded_at.description: UTC, literal Z only -- same rule as release-evidence/v0's occurred_at. An offset timestamp is rejected outright.

supersedes_record_id.description: The record this one corrects, if any. Append-only: superseding never edits or deletes the prior record.

repository_ref.description: Durable identifier (owner/name), never a local filesystem path -- same rule as release-evidence/v0's source.repo.

digest.description: Binds repository_ref + the normalized scan_scope (commit_range, paths, lenses) at scan time. A fix that changes any of these produces a DIFFERENT digest -- the record for the old digest is not retroactively satisfied by a review of the new one (TEST-09).

paths.description: Never omitted, never empty -- a whole-repository scan states so explicitly (e.g. '**/*'), rather than defaulting an absent array to 'everything' (R1: outcome=none_observed_in_recorded_scope can only ever mean 'looked at this recorded scope and found nothing', never 'looked at nothing').

lenses.description: Only the lenses actually applied -- not a declaration of intent. An empty array would mean 'reviewed nothing', which none_observed_in_recorded_scope must never mean.

model_cohort.description: null exactly for human/deterministic_tool (schema-enforced below); a non-empty cohort label for model/hybrid. Never an execution ID or a person's name -- a cohort label, same personal-dimension discipline as agent-metrics/v1.

independence.description: Structured {code, params} record, same shape contracts/shared/derive-independence.mjs already emits (e.g. rec('different_provider', {...})) -- never a numeric independence score.

abstention.description: null unless outcome=abstained (schema-enforced below), in which case {code, params} is required -- never free prose alone.

finding_id.description: Unique within this record (semantic check -- a single-record schema cannot see its own siblings).

claim.description: A single, verifiable claim -- never a bundle of unrelated observations, and never carrying a numeric confidence.

start_line.description: null when the line is genuinely unknown -- never 0 (null-not-zero).

required_verdict.description: The only value this finding can be promoted on -- a finding can never self-declare 'proven', only name what would have to hold.
